auth_details.notes: Static Bearer token — no OAuth, no refresh, no expiry. Test tokens return synthetic Duffel Airways data. Live tokens connect to real airline inventory.

steps.name: search
steps.notes: Passenger types: adult, child (with age), infant_without_seat. Cabin: economy, premium_economy, business, first. Returns offers inline with return_offers=true.

steps.name: refresh_offer
steps.notes: Refresh to get current price. Offers expire 15-30 minutes after search.

steps.name: create_order
steps.notes: Single-step booking. Payment types: balance (Duffel balance) or arc_bsp_cash (IATA). Returns booking_reference (PNR) and documents.

endpoints.purpose: Search flights (create offer request, returns offers inline)
Get available ancillary services (baggage, seats, meals)
Get seat map for offer (query: offer_id)
Get order details (booking status, tickets, segments)
Confirm order change with selected change offer

passenger.notes: Children specify age (2-17). Infants are lap only. Passport required for international (identity_documents array).

offer.notes: Offers expire 15-30 min. expires_at field indicates deadline.

payment.notes: balance = Duffel account balance (test + live). arc_bsp_cash = IATA agent settlement.

quirks.description: Bearer token is permanent — no expiry, no refresh. Rotation is manual via Duffel dashboard.
quirks.workaround: No action needed — token lasts until manually rotated.

quirks.description: Offers expire 15-30 minutes after search. Booking an expired offer returns 404/409. Always refresh before booking.
quirks.workaround: Call GET /air/offers/{id} before POST /air/orders to confirm current price and availability.

quirks.description: Gender format is 'm'/'f' (NOT 'Male'/'Female' like Redbox). Title is lowercase ('mr'/'mrs'/'ms', NOT 'MR'/'MRS'). Using wrong format returns 422 validation error.
quirks.workaround: Map Redbox format to Duffel: Male→m, Female→f, MR→mr.

quirks.description: Cancellation is two-step: POST /order_cancellations (request) → POST /order_cancellations/{id}/actions/confirm. First step returns refund amount, second step finalizes.
quirks.workaround: Always show refund amount to user before confirming.

quirks.description: Single POS — no geographic price arbitrage. Duffel returns the same price regardless of requester location.
quirks.workaround: Use for NDC-exclusive fares, not for arbitrage. Combine with Picasso for best-of-both pricing.
